MLS User Manual

MLS Property Alerts

Estimated reading: 1 minute 405 views

Never Miss the Perfect Property Again!

With the PropertyList “Property Alert” feature, staying on top of new client request has never been easier. Effortlessly save your searches for a contact and receive notifications the moment new properties matching your criteria become available.

Here’s what you’ll enjoy:

  • Save Time: Store your search parameters so you won’t have to re-enter them every time. 1-Click-Search.

  • Stay Updated:

    Get instant notifications when properties matching your saved search criteria are listed—in both your contacts and on the property itself. When you view a property, it recommends your saved clients who are potential matches.

How to Set Up Property Alerts on PropertyList.es:

Save Via Contacts:

    • Go to the desired contact.

    • Find the section labeled “New Property Alert.”

    • Filter your search and save.

No more endless searching—PropertyList’s Property Alerts bring the best properties straight to you!
